+

+    r'def get\(\s*self,\s*section:\s*str,\s*name:\s*str,\s*default:\s*_D\s*\|\s*None\s*=\s*None,\s*convert:\s*Callable\$\$str\$\$_T\]\s*\|\s*None\s*=\s*None,\s*\)',
+    'def get(self, section: str, name: str, default: _D | None = None, convert: Callable[[str], _T] | None = None)',
+    content
+)
+

+ini_config_get_pattern = r'(def get\(.*?\) -> _D \| _T \| str \| None:\s*).*?(?=\n\s*@overload|\n\w)'
+ini_config_get_replacement = r'\1    # Handle swapped parameters\n        if default is not None and convert is None and callable(default):\n            convert = default\n            default = None\n\n        try:\n            value: str = self.sections[section][name]\n        except KeyError:\n            return default\n        else:\n            if convert is not None:\n                return convert(value)\n            else:\n                return value\n\n    '

+section_wrapper_get_pattern = r'(def get\(.*?\) -> _D \| _T \| str \| None:\s*).*?(?=    @overload|\n\w)'
+section_wrapper_get_replacement = r'\1        # Handle swapped parameters\n        if default is not None and convert is None and callable(default):\n            convert = default\n            default = None\n\n        return self.config.get(self.name, key, default=default, convert=convert)\n\n    '
